# hf_tokenizers

HuggingFace tokenizers for Dart over FFI. Load any tokenizer.json and get byte-exact BPE, WordPiece, and Unigram encoding, backed by the Rust crate.

pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/hf_tokenizers
source: https://github.com/Yusufihsangorgel/tokenizers

## Before you call it

README.md carries the usage, the measured comparison against the alternatives, and a note on when not to reach for this package.

## Layout

- `lib/` — public API
- `example/` — runnable examples
- `test/` — the suite; `dart test` (or `flutter test`) runs it
